- Wi-Fi: new coverage map, tap where you are and the floor plan is coloured by signal strength
- Wi-Fi: the speed test shows a smoothed value (2 s average) and no longer keeps a history
- Wi-Fi: "Rogue access points" now only checks the connected network; "Captive portal and DNS" removed
- Wi-Fi: port scan with a fixed 1 s timeout per port
- Bluetooth: new "Beacons" (iBeacon, Eddystone, AltBeacon) and "Earbuds battery" (AirPods and Beats: left, right, case) tools
- Bluetooth: the BLE scanner lists devices in order of detection, so the list no longer jumps around
- Bluetooth: in "Unknown trackers", Find My accessories are grouped under "Apple device"
- Mobile network: new handover log, started and stopped by hand, keeps running with the app closed and exports to CSV
- GNSS: the world map opens full screen (one gesture back to the classic sky) and zooms out to the whole Earth
- SDR: new ACARS decoder (airliner messages) on all 3 European channels at once
- SDR and handheld radio: the cards stay available with no hardware plugged in, only the tools refuse to start
- Handheld radio: support for Quansheng UV-K5, UV-K6 and UV-5R Plus
- Home: a welcome message or a network joke at every launch
- Settings: new opening animation and an "App" section (update checked at every launch, changelog, about)
